William H. Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-w1.htm

He married Lillie Mae SAMMONS who was born into the Kent Co. community on 3 September, 1891. She was the daughter of Edward Sammons and Anna Matthews. They had the following child: Stanley Coker married Ida May Mosley child: Clarence Coker William died on 3 May, 1965 and Lillie Mae on 9 November, 1972. Both are buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, Kent Co., DE
